rules.message: L2 readiness: proposal.md is missing or empty
rules.fix_hint: 创建 .cowork-flow/changes/<slug>/proposal.md 并填写目标、用户价值、范围边界

rules.message: L2 readiness: spec.md is missing or empty
rules.fix_hint: 创建 .cowork-flow/changes/<slug>/spec.md 并填写功能规格

rules.message: L2 readiness: design.md is missing or empty
rules.fix_hint: 创建 .cowork-flow/changes/<slug>/design.md 并填写技术设计

rules.condition: L2 任务必须有 plan 链接
rules.message: L2 readiness: plan link is missing
rules.fix_hint: 在 change.yaml 中添加 plan 字段指向 .cowork-flow/plans/ 下的计划文件

rules.condition: L2 任务必须有 task 链接
rules.message: L2 readiness: task link is missing
rules.fix_hint: 在 change.yaml 中添加 tasks 字段指向相关任务目录

rules.condition: 实现前必须有失败测试（行为变化场景）
rules.message: Implementation without failing test for behavior change
rules.fix_hint: 先编写失败测试，再实现功能，确保测试在实现后通过

rules.condition: check 阶段必须运行验证命令
rules.message: Task completion without running check verification
rules.fix_hint: 运行 ./.cowork-flow/run task review [task-dir] 进入检查阶段，然后运行验证命令

rules.condition: 子代理不派发其他代理
rules.message: Subagent attempted to dispatch another agent
rules.fix_hint: 子代理是叶子执行者，不能派发、等待、列出或取消其他代理

rules.condition: 子代理不修改规格文件
rules.message: Subagent attempted to modify spec files
rules.fix_hint: 规格文件只能由主会话修改，子代理应专注于实现任务
Git 操作只能由主会话执行，子代理应专注于代码实现

rules.message: Subagent attempted to commit or archive
rules.fix_hint: 提交和归档只能由主会话执行，子代理应专注于代码实现
只实现 PRD 中明确要求的功能，不添加额外功能

rules.condition: 不为一次性代码提前做抽象
rules.fix_hint: 保持代码简单直接，只有在确认需要复用时才进行抽象
只修改与当前任务直接相关的代码，不扩大改动范围
